posts.title: Happiness is... embracing a new chapter
posts.description: It's amazing and incredibly humbling to know just how fast time flies in this world. I mean, think about it, we humans are just small, teeny specks in the entire universe that has survived 13.8 billions years. That always makes me marvel at life itself and remind me to be thankful for everything we've got. So it's time to wave goodbye to 2025 and usher in 2026. A new year, new beginning, new hope. There's so much I wanna try to do, change and accomplish this year, like trying new ventures, quitting bad habits, stepping out of my comfort zone and so much more. I also wanna try to cultivate a close and healthy relationship with each of the kids, forge stronger bonds and just be a better mum and a person overall. In this post of "Happiness is..." , it's about embracing a new chapter. I now have two teens, one tween and one preschooler and even if it doesn't look like it, it is quite a handful to handle and some days are just harder than the rest. posts.title: Colours of the World - Ansel's concert 2025
posts.description: This is a day that I look forward to every year - Ansel's annual preschool concert. Even if he is not a graduand yet, I love seeing him shine on stage with his friends, dancing, singing and just having a ball of a time. I also love listening to the graduands' speeches and their parents' heartfelt wishes to them, and can already imagine how I would be tearing up when my lastborn graduates from kindergarten. The theme for his concert this year is "Colours of the World" and the kids get to dress up in different ethnic costumes, sing to multilingual songs and celebrate racial harmony. I love seeing Ansel in the different outfits and it was amazing seeing him dance to the songs with his friends. Of course, I had to make sure I tried my best to capture videos and turn this memorable day into everlasting memories for my darling boy. posts.title: Happiness is... enjoying a whirlwind year-end holiday
posts.description: We always look forward to December because it is always a month filled with lots of fun activities, celebrations, gatherings and family vacations. December 2025 was no exception and in fact, it was one of the best year end holidays we've ever had. Let's see, besides going for family walks, visits to Sentosa, indoor playgrounds and two camps, we also had BBQs, playdates, family get-togethers, movie dates and a Christmas gift exchange. The most important highlight had to be our epic 9D8N road trip to Malaysia where we visited Kuala Lumpur, Genting, Cameron Highlands and Melaka. Yes, super exciting! Of course, we also celebrated Ariel and Asher's birthdays and I can't wait to share more about their celebrations. We also counted down to 2026 and ended the year 2025 with a big bang. In this post of "Happiness is..." , it's about thoroughly enjoying a whirlwind holiday with my loved ones. ****** Guess where we were? We were at the southernmost point of continental Asia, woohoo!
